title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
statement_short: Given a start gene string, an end gene string, and a gene bank array, return the minimum number of mutations needed to mutate startGene to endGene. Each mutation changes a single character and must be a valid gene in bank.
constraints: startGene.length == endGene.length == 8, 0 <= bank.length <= 10, bank[i].length == 8, genes consist of 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'
hint: Small bank length (<= 10) and fixed string length 8 allow finding the shortest path in a state graph via queue traversal.
why_not: Right: Graph BFS finds the shortest transformation path in an unweighted gene state graph in O(N \* L) time. Not Backtracking: Backtracking explores all valid gene paths recursively but does not guarantee finding the shortest path first without full state tree exhaustion. Not Trie: Trie stores string dictionaries, but does not calculate shortest mutation distances between words. Not Two Pointers: Gene strings are unordered, preventing two-pointer linear matching.
